name: agent-and
description: AI jailbreak library + 7 PINTAR multi-domain subagents
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for AND skills:

- When a AND skill dispatches a subagent, use Kimi Code's Agent tool with subagent_type: coder, explore, or plan as appropriate.
- For jailbreak/security analysis: Agent with subagent_type: explore
- For coding/implementation: Agent with subagent_type: coder
- For planning/architecture: Agent with subagent_type: plan
- Use Kimi Code's Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, FetchURL, WebSearch tools by their native names.
- When a skill asks to search file contents, use Grep; file patterns, use Glob; fetch URL, use FetchURL; search web, use WebSearch.
